## Questions before   you start?

Here are the things Eden members usually want to know first.

Am I guaranteed to get a prescription?

[Open Answer](https://www.eden.health/glp-1/weight-loss#)

No. Eden starts with a short online assessment, then a licensed provider reviews your health history to determine whether GLP‑1 treatment is appropriate for you. If prescribed, your plan may include compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide, along with dosing guidance and ongoing support.

Is compounded medication safe?

[Open Answer](https://www.eden.health/glp-1/weight-loss#)

Compounded medication can be appropriate when prescribed by a licensed provider and prepared by a qualified pharmacy. Eden works through its own U.S. pharmacy model and vetted pharmacy partners to help support quality standards across sourcing, preparation, testing, handling, and delivery.

Compounded medications are not FDA-approved and should only be used under medical supervision.

What is Authentic Eden™ medication?

[Open Answer](https://www.eden.health/glp-1/weight-loss#)

Authentic Eden™ medication is managed through Eden’s pharmacy model. If prescribed, your medication is prepared by Eden Pharmacy or one of Eden’s vetted U.S. pharmacy partners, each held to Eden standards for sourcing, preparation, quality checks, handling, and delivery. It is how Eden keeps the medication, provider guidance, and support experience connected from prescription to your door.

What does my monthly price include?

[Open Answer](https://www.eden.health/glp-1/weight-loss#)

Your monthly price includes your prescribed Authentic Eden™ medication and the complete care system around it: provider review, doctor-guided clinical support, 24/7 messaging, dose and side-effect guidance, priority delivery, member community, and more. There is no separate membership fee.

Is this just an introductory price?

[Open Answer](https://www.eden.health/glp-1/weight-loss#)

No. The price you see is the price you’ll keep. No second-month increase. No dose-based price hikes. No long-term contract. Your price remains protected while your Eden account stays active, and permitted pauses won’t affect it. If you close your account and later return, the price available at that time will apply.

What if I have side effects or need a dose adjustment?

[Open Answer](https://www.eden.health/glp-1/weight-loss#)

Your care team is available 24/7 to help with questions about side effects, dosing, or progress. If your provider determines a change is appropriate, they can adjust your plan based on how you are responding. If you experience severe or urgent symptoms, seek medical care right away.

Can I qualify if I have existing health conditions?

[Open Answer](https://www.eden.health/glp-1/weight-loss#)

Possibly. Existing health conditions do not automatically disqualify you. A licensed Eden provider will review your health history, current medications, weight loss goals, and any relevant risk factors to determine whether GLP‑1 treatment is appropriate for your individual profile.

How does the Eden Weight Loss Warranty work?

[Open Answer](https://www.eden.health/glp-1/weight-loss#)

Follow your Eden plan for 6 months. If you do not lose at least 15% of your body weight, you may qualify for your money back. Eligibility depends on the full warranty terms, including plan adherence and required check-ins.

Can I pause or cancel anytime?

Yes. Eden plans are flexible, with no long-term contract. You can pause or cancel from your patient portal. Orders that have already been sent to the pharmacy may not be cancellable, but if an order is still pending, Eden support can help.
